### Celebrating the New Passover
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/celebrating-the-new-passover
Passage: 1 Corinthians 5:8
Points:
- Israel prepared for Passover by completely purging old leaven from every home.
- Paul applies this ritual to church discipline and expelling unrepentant sin from the body.
- Believers are already unleavened and holy because Christ, our Passover Lamb, was sacrificed for us.
- Tolerating persistent sin contradicts the reality of the atonement and risks contaminating the community.
- Christians are called to celebrate Christ by continually pursuing sincerity, truth, and practical holiness.

### Little Sins Can Lead to Big Problems
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/little-sins-can-lead-to-big-problems-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 5:6-8
Points:
- Seemingly minor sins spread through our lives just like a pinch of yeast works through dough.
- Rather than minimizing compromises, believers must take sin seriously and uphold God's standard of holiness.
- Purging the old leaven involves regular confession, turning back toward God, and seeking help from the Holy Spirit.
- Spiritual renewal relies on God's grace, made possible because Christ died as our Passover Lamb.
- Cleaning up little sins early protects our spiritual well-being and guards our relationships.
